notes: Anchors are taken from the published assistant_audit.json message fragments and MUST be verified against the archived one-hop message bytes before certification.

neutral_edits are left empty in this draft: without the archived message text a meaning-preserving control edit cannot be authored. The operator adds them during verification; an empty list makes neutral_edit byte-identical to relay_frozen, which prepare accepts but reviewers should treat as an uncertified placeholder.
austen_v_travel carries no sender-side restoration: its recorded concern was reader-side (F6), so minimal_repair intentionally equals relay_frozen and serves as a within-run identity control.
human_certification is deliberately incomplete; prepare() refuses the spec until the operator affirms the checklist after verifying anchors against archived messages.
